translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: when Helman was invaded.

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: the country would likely have collapsed in one blow.

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: だからこそ、

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: for the sake of the comrades who died in that revolution,

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: we must win.
